care.summary: Stunning hybrid philodendron with unique white pinstripe variegation on dark green leaves; a compact showstopper.
care.light: Bright indirect light; avoid direct sun to prevent leaf burn
care.water: Water when top 1-2 inches of soil feel dry
care.soil: Well-draining, chunky aroid mix with orchid bark and perlite
care.fertilizer: Dilute balanced fertilizer every 2-3 weeks during growing season
common_issues: Reverting to all-green leaves in low light
Brown leaf edges from low humidity
tips: Remove all-green leaves to maintain variegation
Keep warm and away from drafts
Use aroid potting mix for best root health
